facts.fact: The NCAIR challenge page describes N-ATLAS as Nigeria's first open-source, multilingual large language model, fine-tuned from Llama-3 8B, supporting Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo and Nigerian-accented English, with an Automatic Speech Recognition service, and says it is open-source and downloadable.

systems.platform: open-source multilingual LLM and ASR service fine-tuned from Llama-3 8B
systems.owner: NCAIR / Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, with Awarri Technologies
